No house logos, no banners, no people, no text. The hat must look ancient and expressive, not a generic new witch hat.

items.subject: Salazar Slytherin's heavy oval GOLD locket displayed on a small dark-green velvet stand with its fine gold chain draped around the base. Green gemstones form a serpent-like S ornament on the front, stylized as a winding green snake rather than readable typography. Antique gold, one mysterious violet glint, no other jewelry. The small velvet holder and its little foot are DARK forest green and black, no large bright yellow-green platform.

items.label: Vương miện Ravenclaw

A silver EAGLE-shaped central motif and one deep blue gemstone, slender curved wings, no lettering or inscription. Ancient slightly tarnished magical heirloom, NOT a gold royal crown. The cushion is held by FOUR short carved legs. NO single high post or separate floor base.

items.label: Cây thông Giáng sinh nhà Weasley
items.subject: A big homely family CHRISTMAS TREE in a wizard garden: a full fir tree in a wooden tub, decorated with golden fairy lights, red and gold baubles and paper chains, a few wrapped presents around the tub. Cosy, a bit chaotic, funny. The tub and presents are the ground contact on a 2x2 tile. NO post, no slab, no pedestal or ground tile. Retain only the integral little wooden foot where specified.
